checkpoint_selection: best=min same-validation loss; last auxiliary, never substituted
method: Join unique CONTROL edge endpoints by source file/SHA to completed immutable OOF predictions; predictions independently checked against frozen graph labels. Count probabilities in [0,1] units, threshold 1e-12 only for descriptive nonzero counts.
limitations: A file having control edges does not establish that those edges caused its prediction change.
New relation parameters, aggregation, optimization and checkpoint epoch may differ; no per-file intervention was run.
Even files without local new edges can change probability through shared trained parameters and checkpoint selection.
Contract-level classification is aggregated; this does not identify which statement caused a decision.
Single fixed seed; five folds are descriptive CV validation, not independent seeds or independent test.
Missing-anchor and conservative fallback files retained; absence of edges is not proof that source lacks guard semantics.
